def ranks_of(phrase):
    toks = phrase.split()
    adjs = toks[:-1]  # last token is the noun
    cats = [CAT.get(a) for a in adjs]
    return adjs, cats

def ordered(cats):
    rs = [RANK[c] for c in cats]
    return all(rs[i] <= rs[i + 1] for i in range(len(rs) - 1))
